q: total paid in the east last quarter
gold_sql: select sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.region = 'East' and p.paid_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: number of hail claims in oklahoma during 2024
gold_sql: select count(*) as value from core.claims where peril = 'hail' and state = 'OK' and loss_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: how much do we have reserved on open west claims
gold_sql: select sum(reserve) as value from core.claims where status = 'open' and region = 'West' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: avg cost per claim for colorado hail, 3rd quarter 2025 vs the year before
gold_sql: with pt as (select claim_id, sum(amount) paid from core.payments p where p.status <> 'voided' group by claim_id), base as (select c.closed_date, pt.paid from core.claims c join pt using (claim_id) where c.status = 'closed' and pt.paid > 0 and c.peril = 'hail' and c.state = 'CO' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)) select (select sum(paid) / count(*) from base where closed_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30') as value_current, (select sum(paid) / count(*) from base where closed_date between '2024-07-01' and '2024-09-30') as value_prior

q: what share of decided claims did we deny in the south in 2025
gold_sql: select (count(*) filter (where status = 'denied'))::numeric / count(*) as value from core.claims where status in ('closed', 'denied') and region = 'South' and closed_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s)

select count(distinct p.claim_id) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

select c.peril as grp, sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.state = 'OH' and p.paid_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s) group by c.peril

q: january 2025 north water claims compared to january 2024
gold_sql: select count(*) filter (where loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-01-31') as value_current, count(*) filter (where loss_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-01-31') as value_prior from core.claims where region = 'North' and peril = 'water' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: year over year change in claim counts, 2025 vs 2024
gold_sql: select count(*) filter (where loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31') as value_current, count(*) filter (where loss_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31') as value_prior from core.claims where region = any(%(regions)s)

q: whats the typical payout per closed claim in texas this year
gold_sql: with pt as (select claim_id, sum(amount) paid from core.payments p where p.status <> 'voided' group by claim_id) select sum(pt.paid) / count(*) as value from core.claims c join pt using (claim_id) where c.status = 'closed' and pt.paid > 0 and c.state = 'TX' and c.closed_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: loss ratio for each region in 2025
gold_sql: with paid as (select c.region, sum(p.amount) v from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by c.region), prem as (select region, sum(amount) v from core.earned_premium where month between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-01' group by region) select paid.region as grp, paid.v / prem.v as value from paid join prem using (region)

q: fire losses paid in ohio in the first quarter of 2026
gold_sql: select sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.peril = 'fire' and c.state = 'OH' and p.paid_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-03-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)
